title: On Spelling every difficult word aloud
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：spell　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 spell 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the tailor ① spelt every difficult word aloud with great care, and every customer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the tailor ② spells every difficult word aloud on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ spell every difficult word aloud at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ spelt every difficult word aloud before — a line in the order for November 1954 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Spelling every difficult word aloud with great care, the tailor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ spell ruin for the whole family on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Spell ruin for the whole family at once and never mention it again.

By 1967 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the order, and a new customer from the next shop ⑧ spells ruin for the whole family with great care every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the mirror, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ spelt every difficult word aloud again when nobody else would.

⑩ To spell every difficult word aloud, my mother said in 1972, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the shop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the shop forgets, somebody spells every difficult word aloud on the same day again and somebody must spell every difficult word aloud with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 拼写（一般过去式 spelt every difficult word aloud：1960 年裁缝头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 拼写（一般现在 spells every difficult word aloud：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 拼写（不定式 to spell every difficult word aloud：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 拼写（过去完成时 had spelt every difficult word aloud：1954 年十一月的订单簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 拼写（动名词 spelling every difficult word aloud 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 意味着（spell ruin for the whole family：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去意味着意味着这一家人的毁灭）
G. v. 意味着（spell ruin for the whole family：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 拼写（后段两处：新来的顾客照例 spells ruin for the whole family，而母亲又一次 spelt every difficult word aloud）

items.q: to spell every difficult word aloud

answers.why: spell 意为“拼写”，1960 年裁缝小心翼翼地拼写把每个难词都拼出声来，那是裁缝铺里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 spelt。
spell 意为“拼写”，自那以后裁缝当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 spells。
spell 意为“拼写”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯拼写把每个难词都拼出声来”，此处为不定式 to spell every difficult word aloud。
spell 意为“拼写”，订单簿里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1967 年之前就有人拼写过，故用过去完成时 had spelt。
spell 意为“拼写”，裁缝说“拼写把每个难词都拼出声来这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 spelling every difficult word aloud 作主语。
spell 意为“意味着”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去意味着意味着这一家人的毁灭”，should ever 之后用原形 spell ruin for the whole family。
spell 意为“意味着”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻意味着意味着这一家人的毁灭（spell ruin for the whole family at once），以后再也不要提起。
spell 意为“拼写”，新来的顾客每个星期都照例意味着意味着这一家人的毁灭，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 spells。
spell 意为“拼写”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地拼写把每个难词都拼出声来，用一般过去式 spelt 叙述。
spell 意为“拼写”，结尾那句是母亲 1972 年的话：要拼写把每个难词都拼出声来，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和裁缝铺记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1960 年，裁缝小心翼翼地拼写把每个难词都拼出声来；裁缝铺里每一个顾客都说这是头一回。（spelt every difficult word aloud）
多年以后，裁缝仍当天就做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（spells every difficult word aloud）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯拼写把每个难词都拼出声来这件事本身。（to spell every difficult word aloud）
早在 1954 年就有人拼写把每个难词都拼出声来，十一月那天订单簿上的一行字就是证据。（had spelt every difficult word aloud）
裁缝说过，小心翼翼地拼写把每个难词都拼出声来这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（spelling every difficult word aloud 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻意味着意味着这一家人的毁灭，以后再也不要提起。（spell ruin for the whole family，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 spell 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1960 the tailor spelt every difficult word aloud with great care, and nobody in the shop forgot it.
Even now the tailor spells every difficult word aloud on the same day whenever the shop asks.
Spelling every difficult word aloud with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever spell ruin for the whole family on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new customer from the next shop spells ruin for the whole family with great care every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother spelt every difficult word aloud again, and the shop remembered that half.
